items.statement: Payment cycle increased due to event postponements before elections; aim to reduce to 60-70 days and below 60 days in 2-3 quarters
items.quote: Our overall data has increas ed in this year, but we expect it to come down and stabilize it to around, say, 60 to 70 days of payment cycle

items.statement: Company holds INR 30-32 crores in cash, bank balances and FDs as of March 31, 2024
items.quote: So we have around INR 30-32 crores of bank balances and FD. FD has been classified separately from cash and bank.

items.statement: Negative CFO of INR 28.76 crores due to high debtors from postponed events and unutilized IPO funds
items.quote: We had a high amount of debtor in this in the second half, especially due to postponement of certain events. So that is one part. And the remaining, we are holding as cash and cash equivalents, because we had raised capital in second half only and we are yet to deploy it.

items.statement: Plan to increase stake in Dubai subsidiary Maple Heights to 76% in first half of FY25
items.quote: We should be shortly doing it in this half only, in first half itself. And the quantum will be we'll increase our stake to around 76%.

items.statement: Group-promoted companies (healthcare, real estate, FMCG, hospitality) are separate from listed entity; only venue business will merge into Exhicon Media
items.quote: So of all the group companies that you're talking, it is only the venue business, which earlier was separate because of a JV will now entirely move into Exhicon.

items.statement: Exhicon Thailand and hotels (Al Fresco, Blue Sky Lounge) are part of group-promoted company, not the listed entity
items.quote: No, no. It is not part of the liste d entity. It is part of the Exhicon Thailand Company Limited, which is based out of Thailand, and it's a group promoted company

items.statement: Issued warrants worth INR10 crores to Investi Global, a Mauritius-based FPI, received 25% payment, balance 75% expected in coming quarter
items.quote: And the first quarter of FY '25, we also issued warrants of INR10 crores to Investi Global. It's a Mauritius-based FPI. We have received 25% of the payment and the balance 75% we expect to receive in this coming quarter.

items.statement: Already issued warrants worth INR10 crores to Investi Global, received INR2.5 crores in May, balance INR7.5 crores expected this quarter, no further dilution planned as of date
items.quote: So we already done two this in this quarter. Two investing global, just a monetary-based fund. We have issued a warrants worth INR10crores. INR2.5 crores we already received from them in the month of May. And the balance will most probably come in this quarter. Balance INR7.5 crores.

items.statement: Debtor days have come down compared to last quarter
items.quote: So the number of debtor days has actually come down compared to last quarter. So we are doing a little bit better there.

items.statement: IPO proceeds will fund growth without further capital needed until debt reaches INR 1,200 crores
items.quote: We have raise d capital through IPO during this current financial year which will help us to increase our leverage position and without increasing any further capital we will maintain the CRAR as per RBI guidelines till we raise debt of INR 1,200 crores

items.statement: Promoter holding fell from 70.79% to 60.99% due to dilution to long-term investors for expansion and working capital funds.
items.quote: Actually we were approached by long-term investors and as an opportunity we thought this was the right time for dilution. Since we require funds for expansion post API and managing working capital.

items.statement: Cash conversion cycle improved from 130 days in June 2023 to 53 days in June 2024
items.quote: We have seen a steady improvement in our cash conversion cycle from 130 days in June '23 to 53 days in June '24.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents including other bank deposits stood at INR324 million with total borrowing of INR130 million
items.quote: On the balance sheet side, cash and cash equivalent s, including other bank deposit stood at INR324 million with a total borrowing of INR130 million

items.statement: Narayan Gangadhar departed but remains part of IFL Group; ESOP reversal in Q1 FY25 largely relates to his unvested RSUs.
items.quote: Mr. Narayan Gangadhar is still a part of IFL Group, and we have disclosed it in our exchange filing also. And, yes, the major portion in this quarter, reversal effect of RSU, is related to Mr. Narayan Gangadhar sir and some other employees also.

items.statement: Search for a new CEO is ongoing; investors will be updated once finalized.
items.quote: Second, regarding that, CEO, yes, the search is on and we will update the investors as soon as we get the clarification on that.

items.statement: One-time positive PAT impact of INR 8.66 crore from unvested ESOP and RSU cost reversal per Ind AS 102.
items.quote: In this quarter, this also includes a one time positive impact of INR 8.66 Crore with respect to unvested ESOP and RSU costs as per Indian Accounting Standard 102.

items.statement: Cash on hand crossed Rs 100 crore for the first time as of June 2024 and will keep improving.
items.quote: Our balance sheet remains robust. For the first time, we crossed Rs 100 crore in cash on hand as of June 2024, and this number will keep improving as we continue to build a strong business model with investmen ts in labs, centers of excellence, and delivery teams across the three verticals and horizontals

items.statement: Remediation costs running at INR4 crores per quarter, expected to continue at least one more quarter
items.quote: Typically, our remediation has been about INR4 crores per quarter. And we are maintaining the same run rate.

items.statement: Other expenses expected to stabilize at INR110-120 crores per quarter going forward
items.value: INR110 crores , INR120 crores per quarter
items.quote: I cannot directly quantify everything, but I can roughly tell you that you can expect, I think other expenses in total, we'll be able to maintain in the margin of INR110 crores , INR120 crores per quarter going forward.

items.statement: Cash and bank balance excluding receivables is 141 crores as of end of June
items.quote: Minus receivables. 141. crores.

items.statement: Another call of INR 30 on partly paid shares planned for Q4 FY25, 6-9 months away, company does not need capital now
items.quote: There will be another call of INR 30 that we are planning to do in the Q4 of FY of this year. So probably next 6 months to 9 months based on the current requirement.

items.statement: Operating cash flow was poor in H1 due to high inventory and receivables, but CFO says it is temporary and working capital is comfortable
items.quote: Yes, it's more of a temporary phenomenon because we had a high inventory end of June. And at the same time, we had a higher accounts receivable, so it happens and sometimes go up and down.

items.statement: Company received 25% of warrant amount for technology, general development and margin funding
items.quote: Right now, we have taken this by way of warrant, and we have not received full amount, around 25% amount we have received, and it is for overall technology and general development and with margin funding also.

items.statement: Management states current debt position at Spencer's standalone is around Rs. 700 crores, Natures Basket about Rs. 100 crores, consolidated about Rs. 800 crores.
items.quote: The current debt position, yes . So, at Spencer's standalone, it is around Rs. 700 crores and at Natures Basket it is at least about Rs. 100 crores, at a consol level, about Rs. 800 crores.

items.statement: Standalone operational cash flow was Rs 61.84 crore in Q1 FY25 due to reduction of advances to creditors, realization from inventory and trade receivables, and other management measures.
items.quote: Standalone operational cash flow of the company is Rs. 61.84 Crores due to reduction of advances to creditors, realization from inventory and trade receivables and other measures taken by the management.

items.statement: Paid first interim dividend of ₹8 per share during Q1 FY25
items.quote: we have paid the first interim dividend of ₹8 per share during the quarter, demonstrating our commitment to maximizing shareholder value.

items.statement: Epavo will be a 50-50 JV with Ram Ratna Wires; EPACK will be a customer for AC motors, creating related-party transactions on arm's length basis.
items.quote: So, this company, Epavo especially for air conditioned motors, yes, EPACK would be one of the customers. So, there will be some related party transactions to that extent, but yes, since this is the Motor Company especially so we are open to self, we will be catering to almost all the customers.

items.statement: EPACK targets sourcing 40-50% of its motor purchases from Epavo in FY25.
items.quote: I think we would be targeting anywhere between 40% and 50% of EPACK's motor buying from Epavo, let us put it this way.

items.statement: Warrants issued in December 2023 with 18-month subscription period; 25-26% subscribed so far, remaining expected over next 12 months adding ~Rs. 44 crores to net worth
items.quote: warrants basically were issued in December 2023. And the warrants typically has a period of 18 months for the subscription. So just to let you know, around 25% to 26% of the amount has been subscribed, remaining is expected to get subscribed over the next 12 months

items.statement: Management exploring additional capital raise from HNIs and family offices beyond warrant subscription, subject to board approval
items.quote: we are getting interest from HNI from f amily offices to basically be a participant in the long term growth plan of the company. And depending on the calibration as to how we want to basically scale up that particular action will be basically obviously presented to the Board and Board will take a call on whether to raise more capital so in addition to the warrant side of it

items.statement: Board approved 1:10 stock split subject to shareholder approval
items.quote: The Board has also considered and approved a sub-division/split of 1 Equity Share having face value of INR10 each into 10 equity shares having face value of INR1 each by alteration of capital clause in the Memorandum of Association of the company, subject to approval of the members of the company in the ensuing General Meeting.

items.statement: Promoter pledged shares to be released between August and December
items.quote: Yes. So we are looking to clear the pledge between the window of August and December. So most of the pledge should get released between this window.

items.statement: Pre-Ind AS operating cash flow of INR32 crores in June 2024
items.quote: We achieved a strong pre-Ind AS operating cash flow of INR32 crores in June '24.

items.statement: Company initiated equity fundraise of INR2,000 million (INR200 crores) through preferential allotment to drive sustainable growth.
items.quote: Lastly, I would like to share that the company has initiated an equity fundraise of INR2,000 million i.e. INR200 crores through preferential allotment.
